fields.Address: 3000 Hwy 17 Bypass S, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: One of the area's largest water parks, open since 1985. Slides include tube slides, a mat slide and a FlowRider surf wave, and there are family attractions and play areas for younger kids. Cabanas can be rented, and food and shopping are on site. It suits families and groups, with party and group outings available. Seasonal, so check the website for current days and hours.
fields.Name: Myrtle Waves Water Park
fields.Price: Over 48 in. $49.99, under 48 in. $39.99, seniors 55+ and military $44.99; age 2 and under free (plus tax)
fields.Hours Note: Seasonal; closed for the season, reopens in 2027

fields.Address: 300 4th Ave S, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Oceanfront rides since 1966, with the Splashes Oceanfront Water Park on the same grounds. The Swamp Fox, a wooden coaster open since 1966, gives views of the Atlantic, and there are more than 26 rides in all, from the Log Flume and Dragon Coaster to kiddie rides, thrill rides and go-karts. It suits families and groups, with birthday packages and group reservations. Tickets and season passes are sold online.
fields.Name: Family Kingdom Amusement Park
fields.Price: All-day ride wristband $45; military and locals $25; ride credits $1 each (2027 prices)
fields.Hours Note: Closed for the season; the 2026 season has ended. Check the 2027 calendar or call (843) 626-3447.

fields.Address: 301 S Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Parasailing from the Myrtle Beach oceanfront. A second location is at 2985 S Ocean Blvd. Riders go up to 400 feet above the ocean with licensed professionals, on a Coast Guard-inspected 35-foot parasail boat. Flights last 8 to 10 minutes in the air. The company recommends flying between 9 a.m. and 1 p.m., before afternoon winds build.
fields.Name: Downwind Sails Parasailing

fields.Address: 4123 US-17 Business, Murrells Inlet, SC 29576
fields.Short Description: Seakart Adventure is a jet ski and boat hybrid that you drive yourself behind a professional guide boat. Each guided tour lasts 60 minutes and up to three guests can ride in each Seakart. The tour runs out of Crazy Sister Marina in Murrells Inlet and is described as family friendly.
fields.Name: Seakart Adventure SC
fields.Hours Note: Spots fill quickly in peak season; book ahead

fields.Short Description: An aerial adventure park and extreme zip lines in a five-acre forest, with ocean views from the treetops. Choose the Aerial Tour or the Extreme Zip Tour, with KidZipz for younger guests. The park also hosts student and corporate team-building groups. Check the website for current hours.
fields.Name: Radical Ropes Adventure Park
fields.Hours Note: Fall hours: Wed–Fri noon–10 PM, Sat–Sun 10 AM–10 PM, closed Mon–Tue. Last aerial tour 7 PM, last zip tour 8 PM.

fields.Address: 150 Citizens Circle, Little River, SC 29566
fields.Short Description: Wakeboard, kneeboard or water-ski behind a cable instead of a boat, no gear or experience needed, or bounce around a floating inflatable obstacle course. It's on the lake at the North Myrtle Beach Park & Sports Complex.
fields.Name: Shark Wake Park
fields.Hours Note: Seasonal: weekends in spring and fall, daily in summer; hours vary, so call ahead

fields.Address: 5800 Highway 236, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Guided horseback rides on the plantation's private island beach, including one-hour sunset rides, plus waterway trail rides along the Intracoastal Waterway and 15-minute pony rides for little ones. Riders also hear local history, including Battery Hill beside Fort Randall, a Confederate fort. Rides run year round.
fields.Name: Inlet Point Plantation

fields.Address: 1820 21st Ave N, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Seven go-kart tracks, including the Grand Prix Pro track, the High Bank Oval, Slick and a Kids Track, plus two 18-hole mini golf courses, bumper cars, kiddie rides and an arcade with 90+ games. Drivers must meet height minimums for each track, and all-you-can-ride wristbands follow the same limits.
fields.Name: Broadway Grand Prix
fields.Price: All-you-can-ride wristbands $54.99 (48" and up) or $44.99 (40–48"), $5 less online; toddler band $14.99
fields.Hours Note: Hours change by date and season (typically late morning to evening). Check the park calendar before you go.

fields.Address: 1325 Celebrity Cir, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Retro rides carrying on the old Myrtle Beach Pavilion's heritage, in the Broadway at the Beach complex.
fields.Name: Pavilion Nostalgia Park

fields.Address: 2208 N Ocean Blvd, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Aloha Watersports runs parasailing, Big Island banana boat rides, jet ski rentals and pontoon boats in North Myrtle Beach, and has a surf shop on site. It is a one-stop spot for a day on the water for families and groups.
fields.Name: Aloha Watersports

fields.Address: 4 Elm St, Conway, SC 29526
fields.Short Description: Pedal Pub Conway is a two-hour pedal-powered party bike ride through historic downtown Conway and along the riverfront, with stops at local establishments along the way. The bike seats 8 to 15 people. Smaller groups can reserve individual seats, and larger groups such as birthday parties can book the whole bike.
fields.Name: Pedal Pub Conway
fields.Hours Note: Book online; bring a valid ID

fields.Address: 1903 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Coastal Scuba runs dive charters to Myrtle Beach dive sites, teaches certification classes from beginner to PADI professional programs, and sells and rents dive gear. The shop also books dive trips to destinations such as Cozumel, Key Largo, Roatan and Belize.
fields.Name: Coastal Scuba
fields.Hours Note: Hours not posted; see the dive calendar online

fields.Address: 647 Hemingway Ln, Georgetown, SC 29440
fields.Short Description: Back Woods Quail Club near Georgetown is a shooting and hunting preserve with sporting clays, skeet, trap and 5-stand, plus a pistol and rifle range. Quail, turkey, pheasant and deer hunts are offered, with individual and group packages. Call or email the club to book.
fields.Name: Back Woods Quail Club

fields.Address: Broadway at the Beach, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: A 1,000-foot zipline over Lake Broadway and a ropes obstacle course. It is the outdoor add-on to WonderWorks at Broadway at the Beach, in the same complex as the indoor science attraction.
fields.Name: Soar & Explore (WonderWorks)
fields.Hours Note: Closed for the season (fall 2026). WonderWorks itself stays open.

fields.Address: 4042 Hwy 17 Business, Murrells Inlet, SC 29576
fields.Short Description: A family-owned water-sports operator in Murrells Inlet. Choose from parasailing, jet ski rentals and eco tours, banana boat rides, kayak and paddleboard rentals, pontoon boat rentals, dolphin watch tours, sunset and sailing cruises, fishing charters, and scuba charters and classes.
fields.Name: Express Watersports
fields.Hours Note: Office open Mon–Sat 10 AM–5 PM. Parasailing and jet skis run on a seasonal schedule; book online.

fields.Address: 2201 Little River Neck Rd, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Southern Shores Cruises offers a two-hour catamaran island and dolphin cruise, the one-hour Thrill Seeker jet boat ride, a 90-minute Need 4 Speed offshore boating experience, private charters, and jet ski rentals and dolphin tours for drivers 18 and older. Guests should arrive 30 minutes before their scheduled time.
fields.Name: Southern Shores Cruises

fields.Address: 4495 Baker St, Little River, SC 29566
fields.Short Description: A family-run company at Cricket Cove Marina in Little River offering jet ski rentals, guided dolphin sightseeing tours, 2-hour ocean rides and island and waterway tours through the Intracoastal and inlets. Pontoon boats seat up to 15. Beginner rides and guides make it friendly for first-timers and families.
fields.Name: Myrtle Beach Jet Ski Rental

fields.Address: 3000 S Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Oceanfront Helicopters, formerly Huffman Helicopters, flies sightseeing tours over the Myrtle Beach coastline from an office at the end of the airport runway. Routes include the original beach flight, a Broadway tour past the local attractions, oceanfront estates, a family tour and longer routes with wildlife views.
fields.Name: Oceanfront Helicopters
fields.Hours Note: Book ahead; call for flight times

fields.Address: North Myrtle Beach Sports and Recreation Park, North Myrtle Beach, SC
fields.Short Description: A treetop obstacle course with 600 and 900-foot ziplines over a lake. Status needs confirming.
fields.Name: Go Ape Treetop Adventure

fields.Address: 1110 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: A Ferris wheel above the oceanfront with views of the whole Strand.
fields.Name: Myrtle Beach SkyWheel

fields.Address: 4123 US-17 Business, Murrells Inlet, SC 29576
fields.Short Description: A locally owned MarshWalk marina with dolphin and eco tours, sunset and family pirate cruises, holiday fireworks and ghost-story trips, plus head-boat and private fishing charters. Rent pontoon boats, skiffs, kayaks and jet skis, or book a guided jet ski dolphin tour.
fields.Name: Crazy Sister Marina
fields.Hours Note: Fishing trips, jet skis and cruises run on a seasonal schedule. Book online or call (843) 651-3676.

fields.Address: 1525 13th Ave N, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Rent jet skis for the waterway, backwater or ocean, join a 2-hour jet ski dolphin excursion, or take a pontoon out for a half or full day on the Intracoastal.
fields.Name: Action Water Sportz

fields.Address: 1701 S Ocean Blvd, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: New Wave Watersports offers parasailing and banana boat rides from the beach in North Myrtle Beach. Check-in is on the sand behind Molly Darcy's Irish Pub, so you can walk from the beach, board the boat and float high above the coast.
fields.Name: New Wave Watersports
fields.Hours Note: Hours not posted; call or check the booking page

fields.Address: 2349 Dick Pond Rd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29575
fields.Short Description: An indoor and outdoor family fun center with speed-kart racing, bowling, roller skating, laser tag, inflatables, Krazy Darts, virtual reality, an arcade and a two-story PlayPort for kids. Pizza and a full bar are on site, and it also hosts school field trips, birthday parties and group events.
fields.Name: Fun Warehouse

fields.Address: 9589 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Short Description: A family fun park with electric go-kart tracks on two elevated levels, including the Mighty Myrtle and the Wild Woody, plus a rookie track, blaster boats, kiddie rides, a carousel and an arcade. It is part of a small group of Southeast fun parks, and arcade points carry over between locations.
fields.Name: The Track Family Fun Park
fields.Price: Pay-as-you-go point cards: 60 points $55, 125 points $110, 250 points $215
fields.Hours Note: Hours change with the season; call ahead.

fields.Address: Harbourgate Marina, 2100 Sea Mountain Hwy, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Guided jet ski dolphin tours of one or two hours, led by experienced guides, most of them private or semi-private. Tours leave from the company's North Myrtle Beach and Myrtle Beach locations, so check the booking page for the departure point. Riders born after July 1, 2008 must complete a boat rental course before operating a jet ski.
fields.Name: Myrtle Beach Watersports

fields.Address: 1903 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Myrtle Beach Shark Tooth Adventures lets you sift through material brought up from the ocean floor in search of shark teeth and fossils. Several trip levels, from Sandbar to Megalodon, are offered in standard and premium versions, with a booking calendar to check availability by date.
fields.Name: Myrtle Beach Shark Tooth Adventures

fields.Short Description: Twin five-story towers joined by a 600-foot racing zipline, with a ropes course and 50-foot freefall. Address and current status need confirming.
fields.Name: Adrenaline Adventure Zipline

fields.Address: 720 Main St, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: A fully enclosed indoor track with fast electric karts, plus an arcade and pool tables. The track has 14 turns, and adult and junior electric karts give instant acceleration with no indoor fumes. A cafe lounge and a meeting room round out the visit.
fields.Name: K1 Speed
